From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision peak — signature timing & start-date plan (HLX-4721)

Team — looping in the map and the final evaluation cadence so we can lock the closing mechanics. Attached: HLX_MAP_v3.pdf and the Evaluation_Schedule.xlsx (short, by-week breakdown). Key asks in this note: finish legal review, confirm executive signoff window, and agree a firm start date for onboarding.

High level proposal: 
- Final redlines accepted by Redwood legal by EOD Tue 21 Jul (48-hour window).
- DocuSign envelope prepared Wed 22 Jul with a 24–48 hour signer window.
- Preferred start date for the Dedicated capacity: Sat 1 Aug (allows 1 week of post-signing preflight).

Why this cadence: the evaluation runs finish on 29 Jul; locking signatures 22–23 Jul gives procurement time for PO and ensures onboarding resources are scheduled for the 1 Aug start. If procurement needs a later start we can shift to 8 Aug, but that creates a 2-week ramp delay for their pilot metrics.

Can legal (Kimberly) confirm if the redline window is acceptable? Karthik — can you confirm the engineering on-call availability for a potential 1 Aug kickoff (estimated 2 FTE-days of validation)? Priya — confirm that DocuSign is acceptable and whether your procurement team needs any billing PO prior to sending envelope.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: HLX_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP version 3), Evaluation_Schedule.xlsx (2-week cadence)

Thanks Hannah — looks good. A few quick clarifications from Ops and Procurement: 

- DocuSign is fine for signatures. Please include an itemized SOW line for the Dedicated instance and the quarterly commitment so procurement can map to our PO.
- Can we request a 72-hour signer window instead of 24–48? Our execs prefer at least 3 business days to route internally.
- Start date: 1 Aug is preferred, but we may need a 1-week buffer if our internal security checklist has any flagging items (we'll confirm by Thu EOD).

If you can add the SOW line and extend to a 72-hour window, we should be able to commit. Alicia (legal) is CC'd for any contract-level asks.

—Priya

Hannah — legal has completed an initial pass. Summary of redline work: 
- We accepted their requested SLA language for month-1 availability with a 30-day operational review clause.
- We countered on data-retention wording to align with our default 90-day logs retention (see attached Redwood_SOW_redlines_legal.pdf).
- Check: they requested a specific audit log export cadence in the SOW; we proposed a monthly export with ad-hoc exports available on request.

Timing: the 48-hour redline window is tight given the memos from Helios legal. Can we commit to EOD Thu 22 Jul for legal sign-off from our side? That gives Helios a 72-hour signer window starting Fri 23 Jul (DocuSign envelope ready 23 Jul).

If Procurement insists on a 72-hour window, let's schedule envelope-send for Fri 23 Jul and target signatures by Mon 26 Jul. That still gives a reasonable preflight before a 1 Aug start, assuming Helios' security checklist clears by Thu.

Karthik — please confirm engineering that a 1 Aug start is still feasible if signatures land on Mon 26 Jul. If not, what's the earliest feasible start?

Thanks — Kim

Subject: Final: DocuSign sent + kickoff date confirmed (HLX-4721)

Priya / team — quick update and confirmation: 

- Per legal, we prepared the envelope with the accepted redlines. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/12345 (attached envelope stub DocuSign-envelope-12345.pdf).
- We extended the signer window to 72 hours as requested. Envelope sent Fri 23 Jul 16:30 PT; expected complete by Mon 26 Jul 16:30 PT.
- Procurement request: itemized SOW line included in the envelope for Dedicated instance + quarterly commit.
- Engineering availability: Karthik confirms the team is on standby for a 1 Aug start if signatures complete by Mon 26 Jul. If signatures slip beyond Tue 27 Jul, the earliest feasible start is Mon 8 Aug (resource conflicts + training pipeline).

Next steps: 
- Priya: confirm when your PO will be raised (if required) so billing can pre-authorize.
- Marissa: I'll route the final invoice template once envelope completes.
- Karthik: please prepare the validation checklist and a 48-hour on-call rotation for the first two weeks of Aug.

Thanks everyone — close to the finish line. I'll post a short readout once the envelope is completed.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
